_about: Adjudication of every held-out input that did not plainly agree with an independent oracle in the 2026-09-26c run (docs/benchmark/heldout-2026-09-26c.md). reader: OpenReadout returns something wrong or incomplete. unresolved: a disagreement no independent reader can settle yet (counted as a disagreement). oracle: the ground truth or its converter is wrong or follows another convention. gap: the reader refuses a variant it does not support (exit 6) and no oracle exists. no-oracle: no usable independent ground truth. self: the only oracle is our own second implementation.
